# Pull Request

## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Scope

- [ ] Backend (`app/`, `routes/`, `config/`)
- [ ] Frontend (`resources/`)
- [ ] Database (`database/migrations`)
- [ ] Documentation (`docs/`)

## Validation

- [ ] `composer test`
- [ ] `composer lint`
- [ ] `composer format:check`

## Documentation

- [ ] I updated docs under `docs/` when behavior/workflow changed.
- [ ] I did not add non-essential markdown files at repository root.

## Notes

Add screenshots, migration considerations, or rollout notes if needed.
